{{Quote|Jerresk was last sighted in the Fordon system, after he and his henchmen attacked a New Republic supply ship en route to the Musson system.|Airen Cracken, ''Wanted by Cracken''|<ref name="Wanted">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']]</ref>}}
The '''Musson system''' was a part of the [[Karthakk sector/Legends|Karthakk sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of<ref name="Trailing" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> By [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="Date">[[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']] is dated to three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Since ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates that conflict to [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]], the placement of the sourcebook therefore translates to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]].</ref> the [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Jerresk]], along with a group of henchmen, successfully carried out a raid on a [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Supply ship/Legends|supply ship]] traveling to the Musson [[Star system/Legends|system]].<ref name="Wanted" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> the system was mentioned by the New Republic [[General/Legends|general]] [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] in an entry of the [[Datafile/Legends|datafile]] ''[[Wanted by Cracken]]'' dedicated to Jerresk. The entry also listed<ref name="Wanted" /> the [[Savareen sector/Legends|Savareen sector's]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Fordon system/Legends|Fordon system]] as Jerresk's last known location following the attack.<ref name="Wanted" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Musson system was first mentioned in the [[1993]] ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' supplement [[Wanted by Cracken (sourcebook)|''Wanted by Cracken'']], which was written by [[Louis J. Prosperi]] for [[West End Games]].<ref name="Wanted" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed it in grid square Q-16.<ref name="TEA" />
